action_bullets: Built a Flask application with 6 endpoints to track book loans and overdue returns for a classroom demonstration.
Implemented SQL queries and validation rules to prevent duplicate loans and make borrower records easier to maintain.
Created 18 tests covering checkout, return, search and invalid inputs, using a fictional dataset of library records.
Documented installation steps and application routes so classmates could run the project and contribute improvements.
Analyzed 500 records from a synthetic student survey to summarize study patterns and identify missing responses.
Automated data cleaning and generated summary reports to compare results across departments using reproducible Python scripts.
Collaborated with classmates to review assumptions and present findings with clear explanations of the dataset limitations.
